was: Small family-owned campground & bar/grill south of Cameron near Hwy 8/53, on ATV/snowmobile trails. ~30 sites (daily, weekly, seasonal), all with water and 30/50-amp electric; tent sites too. A 23-ft rig fits. Reservable online. Real campground, not just a bar. --Claude
note: Small family-owned grill, bar and campground just south of Cameron, near the junction of Hwys 53, 8 and SS, between the Red Cedar River and the Chetek chain of lakes and right on the ATV trails.  The sites sit among pines and hardwoods, many of them seasonal, and dogs are welcome. --Claude

was: Recreation area on 223-acre Blackhawk Lake between Highland and Cobb. WI DNR owns the land but operations run on an Iowa County easement via the intergovernmental Cobb-Highland Recreation Commission (no state/county tax funding) -- effectively a local-government park. ~135 campsites plus 11 group sites across Main Campground (72 sites), Lower Loop, Beach Sites, and Low Numbers Loop; electric ($27) and non-electric ($17) sites, shower houses, flush toilets, dump/fill station, beach, boat launch. Open year-round (off-season pricing Oct 15-May 1); reservations required, 2-night minimum (3 on holiday weekends), book online. --Claude
note: Recreation area on 220-acre Blackhawk Lake between Highland and Cobb.  The Wisconsin DNR owns the land, Iowa County holds an operating easement and the Cobb-Highland Recreation Commission runs it on no state or county tax money; it is not a state park, and state park passes don't work.  Over 150 open and wooded sites for campers, tents and groups, with shower houses and flush toilets, a beach, a boat launch on a no-wake lake, a nature center and hiking trails.  No generators for now, and no ATVs or UTVs.  As read on 2026-10-14, every reservation has a 2-night minimum, 3 on holiday weekends. --Claude

was: Pierce County park near Plum City on a 116-acre lake (electric motors only). 50 campsites with 30/50-amp electric plus 5 cabins; modern comfort station w/ showers, dump station, water fill, boat ramp, fishing pier. note: Pierce County park near Plum City: 752 acres of semi-wilderness around a 116-acre lake (electric trolling motors only), with 5 heated and air-conditioned camping cabins, a boat ramp and dock, an accessible fishing pier, canoe, kayak and boat rentals, and hiking and cross-country ski trails.  Dogs must be leashed.  There is no swimming beach. --Claude

was: Family-owned since 1974; ~64-65 sites (42 full hookup, 22 electric/water, 6 pull-thru), 30-amp, dump station, hot showers, laundry, free WiFi. Max RV 50 ft, big-rig/slide-out friendly. was: Small private RV park at 928 GA Hwy 26 E, Cochran (opened ~2023-24). ~18-19 full-hookup sites, 20/30/50-amp sub-metered, pull-through and back-in, bathhouse/laundry/dog park. Single-night or extended stay; online reservations via CampLife. Thinly reviewed (RV Life 5★/$$, 1 review) but operator site + active booking confirm a transient drive-in park. No water body. --Claude
note: Small private RV park at 928 GA-26 in Cochran, 2 miles from Cochran Motor Speedway.  Each space has electric and water hookups, a fire pit and a picnic table, and the newly remodeled bathhouse has showers.  It books by phone or email, for a night or an extended stay.  Neither its own site nor its CampLife listing posts a rate; the listing, which pitches the park to snowbirds, traveling professionals and long-term guests, had no site open on any date read from October 2026 to June 2027 (read 2026-10-14). --Claude

was: City of Belle Glade-operated campground on Torry Island in Lake Okeechobee (640-acre island, SE shore). 375 sites, big-rig friendly with 30/50-amp full hookups, plus marina, 6-lane boat ramp, bait shop. Seasonal/snowbird popular but accepts transient daily/nightly stays ($35 W/E, $40-55 full hookup). Reservable online via CampLife. RV Life $$, 4 stars. --Claude
note: City of Belle Glade campground and marina on 640-acre Torry Island, on the southern shore of Lake Okeechobee: security gates, a six-lane boat ramp, a bait and tackle store, a dog park, a nature trail and an 18-hole golf course.  Daily, weekly and monthly stays; reservations by phone. --Claude
